big: A silver ETF returned 14.2% while silver rose 15%. The 0.8-point gap is tracking error. Regulated silver products are easier and cheaper to buy and sell than bars. They have their own fine print.

lines: Which is simpler, an ETF or a fund of funds?

A silver ETF trades on the exchange and tracks the silver price, and you need a demat account. A silver fund of funds invests in silver ETFs and can be bought directly from the fund house, even as a SIP. Watch tracking error and any premium or discount to NAV.
